title: planning_region
description: A governed Kansas Regional Advisory Committee (RAC) planning area identity. Kansas has exactly 14 RAC planning areas that provide regional input into state water planning. Missing or unresolvable geometry must be represented as geometry_confidence: unresolved.

region_id.description: Stable governed identity for this RAC planning area, e.g. kwo-rac-01 through kwo-rac-14.

name.description: Official name of the RAC planning region.

rac_number.description: RAC number 1–14 as enumerated by the Kansas Water Office.

geometry_ref.description: Reference to the geometry record for this planning region, or null if not yet resolved.

geometry_confidence.description: Confidence in the geometry resolution. Missing or unverified geometry must be stored as unresolved, never guessed.

county_crosswalk_ref.description: Reference to the county-crosswalk authority record for this region.

source_ref.description: Reference to the KWO source record providing authority for this identity.
